improvement: English ‘next week’ and French ‘la semaine prochaine’ reported-end-date follow-ups now retain the selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers before fresh source retrieval.
reproduced_before: The supported English and French next-calendar-week forms returned no structured window and lost the selected project set.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only selected source identifiers, a previously established active-only constraint and the newly requested next calendar week carry forward. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and answer facts are excluded.
qualification.period_guard: The next UTC calendar week is frozen to explicit Monday-through-Sunday inclusive bounds before fresh retrieval.
boundary_examples: From 2026-10-08, next week resolves to 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-18 inclusive.
From 2026-12-31, la semaine prochaine resolves across the year boundary to 2027-01-04 through 2027-01-10 inclusive.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: Named competing periods, unnamed mixed-source rosters, compound periods and analytical additions continue through semantic resolution.
qualification.api_guard: The bounded next-calendar-week path skips semantic rewriting and invokes exactly one fresh research lookup in the API test.
qualification.selection_guard: The tested FONGIM and World Bank selection retains identifiers 32 and 664 while excluding stale identifiers 2099 and 999.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a secure signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test bilingual next-week plus current-week, previous-year, previous-month, next-month, current-month, current-year, next-year, explicit-range, mixed-roster, active-only, catalogue, empty-subset, FONGIM selected-ID and geography regressions.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source, explicit-range, next-calendar-year, French current-calendar-year, French-pronoun, current-month, next-month, previous-month, previous-year, current-week or next-week fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 previous-week or topic-change continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only unambiguous next-calendar-week reported-end-date wording uses the new deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets, compound periods and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
